en.name: Pastor Jeff
en.title: A Young Pastor from China
en.preview: At a very young age, God called me out of darkness into an extraordinary journey.
en.verse: "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness."

zh.name: 杰夫牧师
zh.title: 一位来自中国的年轻牧师
zh.preview: 在我很年轻的时候，神便将我从一条完全不寻常的道路上召引出来。
zh.verse: 「我的恩典够你用的，因为我的能力是在人的软弱上显得完全。」
